ideas.pitch: An accessible smartphone assistant tailored for seniors featuring contextual voice guidance and simplified screen navigation.
ideas.title: ElderlyCompanion AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of GrandmaHelper by targeting senior accessibility, a universal pain point that deeply resonates with judges on an emotional and practical level.

ideas.pitch: An interactive clinical simulation platform where medical students interview an AI patient scored on a strict rubric and track CPR posture using computer vision.
ideas.title: MedSim AI Trainer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the blueprint of Clinical-Simulator by offering a complete, demonstrable healthcare workflow with real-time pose estimation and scoring that is easy to live-demo.

ideas.pitch: A hyperlocal civic tech platform featuring a GPS-based walk-to-earn mechanism, an AI marketing copilot for mom-and-pop shops, and a live council engagement dashboard.
ideas.title: CivicPulse Local Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of Catwalk by addressing local civic and economic impact with a polished, highly visual dashboard that judges can immediately understand.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous data incident response agent that intercepts pipeline failures, runs evidence checks, generates verified code repairs, and opens automated pull requests.
ideas.title: DataGuard Incident Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets developer pain points with a hard engineering solution similar to blackbox-datahub, appealing strongly to technical judges looking for practical workflow automation.

ideas.pitch: A smart waste classification pipeline and simulator using computer vision and lightweight ML models to accurately sort recyclables in real time.
ideas.title: EcoSort Robotics Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hardware/simulation integration with clear environmental impact, mimicking the proven approach of ROBOTICS-ai-garbage-classifier with a live visual classifier demo.
